title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY – Dr. Khubchand Baghel Swasthya Sahayata Yojana Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Integrated government health assurance programme in Chhattisgarh providing cashless treatment packages through the state/PM-JAY network.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility follows the applicable Chhattisgarh beneficiary categories and PM-JAY/state scheme rules; beneficiary verification is required.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY – Dr. Khubchand Baghel Swasthya Sahayata Yojana.

nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
